populations.full388: four original H5 plans then 384 round-major frozen parent CEM queries
populations.diagnostic: eight archived slots per root, with six distinct bank indices used once in metrics

protocol.C/L/F: decoded actual arrival / one-step true mode at prior actual three-frame window / matching free-rollout mode
protocol.errors: Euclidean endpoint RMSE and the first positive collision-strip depth or wrong endpoint room
protocol.prior_decoded_replay: exact same mode and five controls from preceding F for F or preceding C for C/L (frozen root readout at H1)
protocol.progress: common-block projection from factual start onto net command; legal-route goal progress and signed projection along actual root displacement
protocol.legal_route: navigation branch with an actual raw crossing and lower physical H5 goal cost than root
protocol.evidence: frozen archived scales, paired arrivals from each valid actual same-prefix source, shared H1 counted once per bank index
protocol.paired: layout metric deltas, complete layouts only, 10000 resamples of whole paired layouts
protocol.selection: selected frozen CEM tail is conditioned on the original scorer; bank ranking and room flags also use all proposals
